paper_title: Knowledge Crosswords Geometric Knowledge Reasoning with Large Language   Models
caption: Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot.
model_annotation: The image presents three pie charts, collectively illustrating the distribution of problems based on their correctness under the with knowledge and without knowledge settings using Zero-Shot. Each chart represents a different level of difficulty: easy, medium, and hard. The charts are divided into four slices, representing the categories N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-, which are color-coded in teal, yellow, orange, and red, respectively. The easy chart consists of four slices, with N+K+ at 55.4%, N-K+ at 38.3%, N-K- at 4.6%, and N+K- at 1.7%. The medium chart also has four slices, with N+K+ at 58.8%, N-K+ at 35.4%, N-K- at 4.0%, and N+K- at 1.8%. The hard chart similarly comprises four slices, with N-K- at 37.9%, N-K+ at 37.3%, N+K+ at 18.1%, and N+K- at 6.7%. A legend is provided to the right of the charts, detailing the color coding for each category. The slices are labeled with their corresponding percentages, and no slices are visually emphasized or ordered in a specific way beyond their size representation of the proportion.
